title: Reishi Spore Cloud
description: Lacquered reishi (lingzhi) growths quietly releasing fine cocoa-brown spores. Grow them as the classic flat shelf conk on a stubby trunk, as the branching deer-antler form (Ganoderma antler), or both, with one to four of them placed at randomised spots along the ground. The spores stream off the pore surface (or the antler tips) as a fine, laminar flow that shears into layered sheets and curls on slow turbulence, backlit so the dense parts glow golden-brown like dust in a shaft of light. An optional iridescent glimmer gives a fraction of the spores an oil-slick sparkle. Emission, turbulence, rise-versus-settle, wind, conk count, growth form, iridescence, spore hue and glow are live; the growths can be hidden, and with the mic on each beat sends up a fresh puff.
